verified_facts.text: The hotel is the tallest hotel in Ljubljana, with a glass exterior.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the tallest hotel in Ljubljana, with an iconic glass exterior

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites feature marble bathrooms and city views.
verified_facts.excerpt: you'll unwind in luxurious rooms and suites featuring elegant marble bathrooms and stunning city views

verified_facts.text: Rooms have a marble bathroom with a soaking tub or walk-in shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Escape to a tranquil marble bathroom and unwind in a soaking tub or walk-in shower.

verified_facts.text: All guest rooms are available with king beds, a work-desk area and free Wi-Fi.
verified_facts.excerpt: All guest rooms are available with king beds, a work-desk area, free Wi-Fi, and unique views.

verified_facts.text: B-Restaurant and Bar spans the entire 20th floor and includes a restaurant, an outdoor terrace and a bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: spans the entire 20th floor of the building and includes a restaurant, an outdoor terrace, and a bar

verified_facts.text: The rooftop restaurant and bar have a 360-degree view over Ljubljana's old town, with the castle on one side and the Alps on the other.
verified_facts.excerpt: The restaurant and bar have a spectacular 360 degree view overlooking the old town Ljubljana with the castle on one side and the Alps on the other.

verified_facts.text: The B-Restaurant menu celebrates the range of Slovenian produce and products.
verified_facts.excerpt: The menu is elegant, yet recognizable and approachable, celebrating the vast range of Slovenian produce and products.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop B-bar has an outdoor terrace with views of the Old Town, the castle and the surrounding Alps.
verified_facts.excerpt: Settle back on the outdoor terrace with an expertly mixed cocktail or a glass of wine to enjoy dazzling views of the Old Town, the castle and the surrounding Alps.

verified_facts.text: Bloom Lounge, next to the lobby, is filled with plants and serves freshly brewed coffee with croissants or cakes inspired by French cuisine with a local twist.
verified_facts.excerpt: This meticulously designed space boasts an abundance of plants, creating a peaceful ambiance perfect for enjoying freshly brewed coffee paired with croissants or cakes inspired by French cuisine with a delightful local twist.

verified_facts.text: The indoor swimming pool is on the 18th floor, with views of Tivoli Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: our indoor swimming pool located on the 18th floor of the prestigious Hotel InterContinental Ljubljana and enjoy the stunning views of the Tivoli Park

verified_facts.text: The indoor pool is heated and includes a whirlpool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pool includes: Whirlpool

verified_facts.text: The 18th-floor gym has personal trainers and a relaxation space with 360-degree skyline views of Ljubljana.
verified_facts.excerpt: Achieve new personal bests with the help of our personal trainers and modern equipment at our 18th-floor gym. Enjoy a serene relaxation space with 360º skyline views of Ljubljana.

verified_facts.text: After a workout, guests can have a freshly squeezed juice from the gym's vitamin bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: After your workout, rehydrate with a freshly squeezed juice from our vitamin bar.

verified_facts.text: Serenity SPA offers a sauna, steam bathing, massages, facials, beauty treatments, manicures and pedicures.
verified_facts.excerpt: Serenity SPA

verified_facts.text: Guests can explore the city on the hotel's custom city tours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step outside into historic Old Town and explore the city by taking one of our custom city tours.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in the center of Slovenia's capital, close to Ljubljana Castle, the Triple Bridge and the historic old town.
verified_facts.excerpt: InterContinental Ljubljana sits in the center of Slovenia’s lively capital. Discover top attractions like Ljubljana Castle, the Triple Bridge, and the historic old town.

verified_facts.text: Tivoli Park and Ljubljana Old Town are each about half a kilometer from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tivoli Park - 0.31 miles away (0.5 kilometers)

verified_facts.text: Lake Bled is suggested as a day trip from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: For an unforgettable day trip, explore nearby Bled, famous for its stunning lake.

verified_facts.text: Dogs up to 12 kg are welcome in guest rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dogs up to 12 kg are welcomed and allowed in rooms only.

verified_facts.text: Dogs receive a dog pillow, drinking bowl and small toy in the room.
verified_facts.excerpt: For our guests with dogs, we will happily provide a dog pillow in the room, drinking bowl and a small toy.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is certified with Green Key.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel is certified with Green Key (FEE)
